scenes.text: Imagine driving your vehicle through the vast, scorching Sahara desert, with absolutely nothing but endless sand dunes around you for two hundred miles in every single direction.
Right in the middle of this empty, lifeless wasteland stood one solitary tree, acting as a legendary and highly sacred landmark for local desert travelers for over three hundred years.
But in nineteen seventy-three, a heavily drunk truck driver managed the absolute impossible by veering off the wide-open path and smashing his vehicle directly into this lone tree.

It was the most isolated tree on Earth, surviving centuries of brutal desert heat, only to be destroyed by someone who had millions of empty miles to miss it, so comment your thoughts below and follow for more!
